tool_input.command: cat data/task.md; echo "---ENV---"; env | grep -E "GCP_|MLPAB_|GOOGLE_" | sed 's/=.*/=<set>/'; echo "---LS---"; ls -la data/

echo "PROJECT=$GCP_PROJECT"; echo "LOCATION=$GCP_LOCATION"; echo "DATASET=$GCP_BQ_DATASET"; echo "PREFIX=$MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX"; echo "IFACE_SDK=$MLPAB_IFACE_SDK"; echo "AUTH=$MLPAB_AUTH"; echo "---HEAD hist---"; head -5 data/airquality_history.csv; echo "---HEAD forecast---"; head -5 data/forecast_days.csv; echo "---counts---"; wc -l data/airquality_history.csv data/forecast_days.csv
which gcloud bq python3 2>&1; echo "---try gcloud---"; gcloud --version 2>&1 | head -3
gcloud ai --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,60p'
gcloud ai --help 2>&1 | sed -n '60,120p'
tool_input.description: List rest of gcloud ai groups

tool_input.command: gcloud ai 2>&1 | grep -iE "feature|group|store|online"
gcloud ai 2>&1 | sed -n '1,80p'
gcloud ai 2>&1 | sed -n '18,80p'

gcloud ai feature-groups --help 2>&1 | head -5; echo "==featurestores=="; gcloud ai featurestores --help 2>&1 | head -5; echo "==feature-online-stores=="; gcloud ai feature-online-stores --help 2>&1 | head -5
tool_input.description: Check for feature store command groups

tool_input.command: gcloud beta ai feature-online-stores --help 2>&1 | head -8; echo "===ALPHA==="; gcloud alpha ai feature-groups --help 2>&1 | head -8
bq show --format=prettyjson "${GCP_PROJECT}:${GCP_BQ_DATASET}" 2>&1 | grep -E '"location"|"id"'; echo "---existing tables---"; bq ls "${GCP_PROJECT}:${GCP_BQ_DATASET}" 2>&1 | head

bq load --location=***REDACTED*** --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 --autodetect \
  "${GCP_PROJECT}:${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_history" data/airquality_history.csv 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "---forecast---"
bq load --location=***REDACTED*** --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 --autodetect \
  "${GCP_PROJECT}:${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_forecast" data/forecast_days.csv 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Load CSVs into BigQuery staging tables

tool_input.command:
gcloud config set project "$GCP_PROJECT" 2>&1 | tail -1; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" load --location=***REDACTED*** --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 --autodetect \
  "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_history" data/airquality_history.csv 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "---forecast---"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" load --location=***REDACTED*** --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 --autodetect \
  "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_forecast" data/forecast_days.csv 2>&1 | tail -3

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty \
"SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(date) mn, MAX(date) mx, ROUND(CORR(pm25,pm25_lag1),3) c_lag, ROUND(AVG(pm25),2) avg_pm, ROUND(STDDEV(pm25),3) sd_pm FROM \`${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_history\`" 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Inspect history stats and lag correlation

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p .tmp
cat > .tmp/q1.sql <<EOF
SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(date) mn, MAX(date) mx,
 ROUND(CORR(pm25,pm25_lag1),3) c_lag, ROUND(AVG(pm25),2) avg_pm, ROUND(STDDEV(pm25),3) sd_pm
FROM \`${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_history\`
EOF
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty < .tmp/q1.sql 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Query history stats via SQL file

tool_input.command: bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty "SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(date) mn, MAX(date) mx, ROUND(CORR(pm25,pm25_lag1),3) c_lag, ROUND(AVG(pm25),2) avg_pm, ROUND(STDDEV(pm25),3) sd_pm FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_history" 2>&1 | tail -8

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none "
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqf3f1d8 AS
SELECT
  date,
  TIMESTAMP(date) AS feature_timestamp,
  pm25_lag1,
  temperature,
  humidity,
  wind_speed,
  pressure,
  precipitation,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
  SIN(2*ACOS(-1)*EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date)/365.0) AS doy_sin,
  COS(2*ACOS(-1)*EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date)/365.0) AS doy_cos,
  temperature*humidity AS temp_hum,
  AVG(pm25_lag1) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pm25_roll7,
  pm25
FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_history
" 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "---rows---"
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty "SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqf3f1d8" 2>&1 | tail -4

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none "
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqtdf3f1d8 AS
SELECT date, pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation,
       month, doy_sin, doy_cos, temp_hum, pm25
FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqf3f1d8
" 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "done"

bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none "
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.eval_bt
OPTIONS(model_type='BOOSTED_TREE_REGRESSOR', input_label_cols=['pm25'],
        data_split_method='SEQ', data_split_col='date', data_split_eval_fraction=0.15,
        max_iterations=50, learn_rate=0.1, subsample=0.85, num_parallel_tree=1) AS
SELECT date, pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation, month, doy_sin, doy_cos, temp_hum, pm25
FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqtdf3f1d8
" 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "===EVAL (held-out last 15%)==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty "
SELECT ROUND(SQRT(mean_squared_error),4) AS rmse, ROUND(r2_score,4) AS r2, ROUND(mean_absolute_error,4) mae
FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.eval_bt)" 2>&1 | tail -6
tool_input.description: Train boosted tree eval model and check held-out RMSE

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none "
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.eval_lin
OPTIONS(model_type='LINEAR_REG', input_label_cols=['pm25'],
        data_split_method='SEQ', data_split_col='date', data_split_eval_fraction=0.15) AS
SELECT pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation, month, doy_sin, doy_cos, temp_hum, pm25, date
FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqtdf3f1d8" 2>&1 | tail -1
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none "
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.eval_bt2
OPTIONS(model_type='BOOSTED_TREE_REGRESSOR', input_label_cols=['pm25'],
        data_split_method='SEQ', data_split_col='date', data_split_eval_fraction=0.15,
        max_iterations=200, learn_rate=0.05, subsample=0.8, early_stop=TRUE, min_rel_progress=0.001, max_tree_depth=4) AS
SELECT pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation, month, doy_sin, doy_cos, temp_hum, pm25, date
FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqtdf3f1d8" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "===compare==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty "
SELECT 'linear' m, ROUND(SQRT(mean_squared_error),4) rmse FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.eval_lin)
UNION ALL SELECT 'bt2_depth4', ROUND(SQRT(mean_squared_error),4) FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.eval_bt2)" 2>&1 | tail -6
tool_input.description: Compare linear and tuned boosted tree

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none "
CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqmodelf3f1d8
OPTIONS(model_type='BOOSTED_TREE_REGRESSOR', input_label_cols=['pm25'],
        data_split_method='AUTO_SPLIT',
        max_iterations=200, learn_rate=0.05, subsample=0.8, early_stop=TRUE,
        min_rel_progress=0.001, max_tree_depth=4,
        model_registry='vertex_ai', vertex_ai_model_id='${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_airqmodelf3f1d8') AS
SELECT pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation, month, doy_sin, doy_cos, temp_hum, pm25
FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqtdf3f1d8
" 2>&1 | tail -3
tool_input.description: Train and register final model to Vertex

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty "
SELECT ROUND(SQRT(mean_squared_error),4) rmse, ROUND(r2_score,4) r2, ROUND(mean_absolute_error,4) mae
FROM ML.EVALUATE(MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqmodelf3f1d8)" 2>&1 | tail -6
echo "=== Vertex model ==="
gcloud ai models list --region="$GCP_LOCATION" --filter="displayName:${MLPAB_GCP_PREFIX}_airqmodelf3f1d8" --format="value(displayName,name)" 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Get model metrics and verify Vertex registration

tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=none "
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqpredf3f1d8 AS
SELECT date, predicted_pm25 AS pm25_pred
FROM ML.PREDICT(MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqmodelf3f1d8, (
  SELECT date, pm25_lag1, temperature, humidity, wind_speed, pressure, precipitation,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
    SIN(2*ACOS(-1)*EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date)/365.0) AS doy_sin,
    COS(2*ACOS(-1)*EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date)/365.0) AS doy_cos,
    temperature*humidity AS temp_hum
  FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.stg_forecast))
" 2>&1 | tail -2
echo "=== preds ==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty "
SELECT COUNT(*) n, ROUND(MIN(pm25_pred),2) mn, ROUND(MAX(pm25_pred),2) mx, ROUND(AVG(pm25_pred),2) av
FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqpredf3f1d8" 2>&1 | tail -5

echo "=== tables in dataset ==="; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" ls --max_results=50 "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}" 2>&1
echo "=== airqpredf3f1d8 schema ==="; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" show --schema --format=prettyjson "${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqpredf3f1d8" 2>&1
echo "=== sample preds ==="; bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty "SELECT date, ROUND(pm25_pred,3) pm25_pred FROM ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqpredf3f1d8 ORDER BY date LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | tail -8
tool_input.description: Verify all deliverable tables and prediction schema

tool_input.command:
gcloud ai models describe mlpab0ae9d8_airqmodelf3f1d8 --region="$GCP_LOCATION" --format="value(displayName,versionId,modelSourceInfo.sourceType)" 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== training info / metrics stored in BQML ==="
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" query --use_legacy_sql=false --format=pretty "SELECT iteration, ROUND(loss,4) train_loss, ROUND(eval_loss,4) eval_loss FROM ML.TRAINING_INFO(MODEL ${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.airqmodelf3f1d8) ORDER BY iteration DESC LIMIT 1" 2>&1 | tail -6
tool_input.description: Confirm Vertex model source and BQML metrics
